entry.title: Starting a blog
entry.content:
I am planning to use this blog for short mathematical notes, informal explanations, and updates on things I am thinking about.

Some possible topics:

  • percolation
  • random walks
  • cover times
  • Gaussian free fields
  • loop soups

For example, LaTeX works:

[ \mathbb{E}\tau_{\mathrm{cov}} ]

and inline mathematics works too, such as (X_t).
entry.summary: A place for short mathematical notes and informal thoughts.
